title: Bucs elevate QB Easton Stick from practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bucs elevate QB Easton Stick from practice squad
sources.description: The Buccaneers elevated linebacker Caden Fordham and quarterback Easton Stick from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Packers, the team announced.
